items.title: SADC and development partners reaffirm regional integration priorities

items.summary: UNCTAD's Trade and Development Report 2026 describes slower global growth, resilient Asian economies, shifting trade relationships and increasing importance of technology and geopolitical policy barriers.

items.title: Botswana external-sector statistics: latest quarterly bulletin
